A lip on the top edge of a tray's wall (mitcad#2445): t = 1, r = 1, K = 0.44 (BA/2 = 0.36 pi = 1.1309734), a 200 x 100 face, Bend Line flanges of Inner Length 10: SheetFlange1 on the long edge y = 0 (Corner Open), SheetFlange2 on the other three edges (mitred where they meet, a Corner Gap of 1 short of SheetFlange1's wall). The walls stand 10 high (z = 1..11), their inner surfaces 0.1309734 inside the face's edges; SheetFlange1's wall runs the whole edge, x = 0..200, the end walls' inner surfaces at x = 0.1309734 and 199.8690266.

The lip: a Flange of the same options on the top edge of SheetFlange1's wall (its curve 51), folded in over the tray (the default way, towards the wall's back). It would pass 0.1309734 into the end walls' tops at both ends (it was refused naming those walls); its ends keep the Corner Gap (the thickness, 1) short of the end walls' inner surfaces: x = 1.1309734 .. 198.8690266, 197.7380533 wide. Its bend (0.75 pi per mm) and wall (9 per mm: Inner Length 10 less the inner setback r) over that width; the wall's top cut back by BA/2 over the whole 200 (the lip's trim, and beside the lip's ends to its tangent line, as a flange's end at a corner is). The tray's volume (26065.98077) + 197.7380533 (9 + 0.75 pi) - 200 BA/2.
Flipped: folded out over the tray's side, clear of every wall, the whole 200 wide (as before): + 200 (9 + 0.75 pi - BA/2).

On a short wall (SheetFlange2's first wall, x = 200): its top edge ends a Corner Gap short of SheetFlange1's wall and at the mitre of the far corner, so the lip, in or out, clears every wall as it is (98.03 wide): the same volume both ways.

A lip that really passes through a wall: 120 long, folded in, it crosses the tray to the far long wall (SheetFlange2's second wall). Refused naming the new flange and the wall it hits, and saying what to change.

expect.error_contains: sheet walls SheetFlange2 (wall 2) and SheetFlange3 pass through each other
Flip the flange, or make it shorter or narrower
